summary: E2E backend + frontend testing of the new 'VA Digital Services' feature. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (digital-settings GET/PUT persist, VA digital lead create w/o property_size, cleaning 400 guard, /pm/leads?category=digital|cleaning filter isolation, stage progression contacted→quoted→booked→completed→paid with $300 commission at 10%, assign-va, /va/projects, va can fetch assigned-lead detail). Frontend: all 10 requested UI flows PASS (VA sidebar nav, /va/digital banner + form toggle, submit digital lead w/ live commission preview, admin /ops/va-program/digital 4 KPIs + rate save+persist across reload+restore, per-row stage buttons digital-move-{leadId}-{stage}, job-value input + move-to-paid, digital-lead-link → lead detail with $300 commission + DELIVERY VA sidebar card, activity row 'Delivery VA assigned', edit form shows field-estimated_budget + service optgroup with Digital services, digital lead size shows '—' in view mode). Two minor cosmetic observations noted below.

design_issues.screen: LeadDetail edit form for a digital lead
issues: When entering Edit mode on a digital lead that has no property_size, the SIZE dropdown defaults to 'Studio' instead of showing an empty/'—' selection. Saving without noticing could accidentally set property_size='studio' on a digital lead. Consider adding an empty first option or hiding the SIZE field entirely for digital service types.

Commission sidebar shows the correct amount ($300.00 = 3000 × 10%) and status PENDING APPROVAL, but does NOT surface a visible 'digital_pct' calc-note / kind label. Review request explicitly asks for 'kind digital_pct calc note' to be visible so PMs can distinguish digital-percentage commissions from cleaning-tier commissions. Nice-to-have visibility improvement.

test_results.backend_property_size_guard: PASS — POST /api/va/leads with service_type=deep and no property_size returns 400 'Property size is required for cleaning services.' Digital service types accept payload without property_size
test_results.regression_category_filter: PASS — GET /api/pm/leads?category=digital returns only leads whose service_type ∈ digital family (6); ?category=cleaning excludes them

critical_code_review_comments: AdminVADigital edit form: when editing a digital lead the SIZE dropdown defaults to 'Studio' instead of leaving property_size null — risk of silently attaching a cleaning-only field to a digital lead on Save. Should add an empty '— none —' option OR conditionally hide the SIZE field when service_type ∈ DIGITAL_SERVICE_TYPES.

LeadDetail commission sidebar does not label the commission calc kind (digital_pct vs tier-based). Adding the calc_notes or a small badge (e.g. '10% of $3000') would satisfy the review-request requirement and help PMs during audits.

The delivery-VA <select> (digital-assign-va-{leadId}) renders duplicate VA entries (e.g. 'VA X' appears many times). Same underlying dataset seems to be loaded/duplicated across rows or across group re-renders — appears cosmetic since selecting VA Demo works, but list is very long and confusing. Suggest de-duplicating by user_id and sorting alphabetically.
action_items: Add 'digital_pct' calc note / label (e.g. '10% of $3000.00') to $ COMMISSION sidebar on LeadDetail for digital leads
Fix SIZE dropdown default in LeadDetail edit form so digital leads don't accidentally get property_size='studio' on Save (either hide field for digital service_type or add empty option)
De-duplicate the digital-assign-va-{leadId} <select> options (many repeated names like 'VA X', 'PM Created VA')
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of TEST_iter_digital_* leads (web_development, budget 2000 & 3000) under va.demo. Lead lead_c47a8cb69423 (TEST_iter_ui_digital_1782961678) progressed to PAID at job_value=3000, commission=$300, delivery VA=VA Demo. All seed rows are prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VA Digital Services feature is fully functional end-to-end. All data-testids from review request exist and work. Digital commission rate is currently 10%. The only follow-ups are cosmetic: (1) SIZE dropdown default in edit form for digital leads, (2) missing digital_pct calc note in commission sidebar, (3) dedupe of assign-va select options. Backend responses use `commission_pct` key (not digital_commission_pct) and the assign-va endpoint expects payload {va_user_id}. Stage endpoint is PUT /api/pm/leads/{lead_id}/stage.
